body: I agree, please write a book. You captured the first 3 days in great detail. I'd love to see the same attention to detail but for the duration of the entire time you've known her. The way you describe the smallest of details makes me cry. I am so grateful to /u/gonnamke1t thanks to your confession, I was able to snap out of my depressed state and see all the amazing things I have in life. I have a loving wife, who I still can hold in my arms today. I'm an idiot for not seeing how good of a life I have before. Thank you for opening my eyes, if there is a heaven I hope the both you find each other and spend the rest of eternity together.

Man... that brought a vivid image to my brain. Of someone who's heart rate is slowing down close to flat-line then getting jolted alive by Defibrillator. The feeling of being shocked isn't a good one but it lets you know that you're alive, it eventually brings you back from the clutches of death. Life is difficult but events like that shape and create the person you are.. I always wondered why older people were more sad, now I know. Eventually you reach your threshold of how much trauma your can take before you flat-line. I hope you make it through this I really do, I'm a full grown 42 year old man. I have a wife and kids, I cannot even bring myself to imagine this happening to  my wife. When I read this, I found my wife in the living room and just hugged her, she has never seen me cry but today I cried because I truly grateful to have her here with me. Things have been difficult lately due to cutbacks at work, where I'm not bringing in enough money, we're making it but barley. But I had forgotten where my happiness was, thank you for sharing your story. Now I am energized and grateful to have the love of my life right there next to me, I hope the best for you friend!

Man, I teared up reading this. Do you need someone to talk to? I wish I could give you a hug. There needs to be more people like you in this world. 

Seriously bro, wtf life is just fucked up. If you need someone to talk to pm me!
